item.title: "Trump says the Iran ceasefire is 'on life support' after rejecting an Iranian proposal"
"טרום: 'השיק'
item.description: President Donald Trump told reporters the Iranian response to a U.S. peace proposal was “stupid” and that the ceasefire is “on massive life support.” NBC News' Jon Allen reports on the war's impasse and how Trump responded to questions over his meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping later in the week.

item.title: "הנשיא טרומן דחה את התעלול של איראן. ו, קונגרס לחם את תפוצ' ICE"
item.description: "Trump סרח על תגבורת Iran's response to a U.S. peace proposal, calling it 'totally unacceptable.' And, Congressional Republicans are trying to push for three years of funding for immigration enforcement."
